fact: The Zambia Statistics Agency says Zambia's 2022 Census of Population and Housing, its sixth and first electronic census, was conducted; the enumeration date is not given.
The Zambia Statistics Agency, Ministry of Health and ICF published the final report of the 2024 Zambia Demographic and Health Survey in November 2025; fieldwork ran in 2024.
Zambia's 2022 Census of Population and Housing, its sixth national census, was enumerated from 18 August to 21 September 2022; preliminary results were released on 23 December 2022.
The Zambia Statistics Agency's Population Summary Report Volume Two, dated June 2024, gives final population figures of the 2022 census (total 19,693,423).

The Zambia Statistics Agency's national analytical report presents results from the 2022 Census of Population and Housing, which collected education and literacy data (national literacy 62.6 percent among people aged 5 and older); the document gives no exact enumeration date, so the year 2022 is used.
